info.comment: Please check out my other projects too!Apologies for any small glitches like the opponent attacking you twice in one turn, or the opponent's second pokemon appearing at the same time as their first pokemon. It's not the coding, it's the fact that there's soo much of it and scratch seems to struggle to keep up a little.Use the arrow keys to move your character at first, then all you need is the mouse to select your pokemon from the PC Box and select the moves you want. Type matchups, same type attack boosts, etc, it's all in there (except critical hits and misses, those are annoying).I hope you enjoy this small celebration of pokemon.
